title: Bounded-below injective resolutions in a category of varying-site coefficient systems
statement: Let $I$ be a small category and let $\mathcal C_i$ be small sites [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For every $a:j\to i$ give a morphism of sites $f_a:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$, with exact additive inverse image on abelian sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-site-pullback-abelian-exact], and give the canonical identity and composition identifications satisfying their coherence laws. Define $\mathscr S$ to have objects $(F_i,\phi_a)$, where $F_i\in\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C_i)$ and $\phi_a:f_a^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ obey the identity and cocycle laws; a morphism $(F,\phi)\to(G,\psi)$ is a family $h_i:F_i\to G_i$ satisfying $h_j\phi_a=\psi_a f_a^{-1}(h_i)$. Then $\mathscr S$ is an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] whose kernels and cokernels are computed at every $i$. It has enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and each evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_i:\mathscr S\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C_i)$ is exact and sends injective objects to injective objects. For every integer $b$ and every cochain complex $K$ of $\mathscr S$ with $K^n=0$ for $n<b$, there is a degreewise monomorphic quasi-isomorphism $s:K\to J$ of system complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with $J^n=0$ for $n<b$ and every $J^n$ injective in $\mathscr S$. In particular all $J_i^n$ are injective abelian sheaves and all $s_i:K_i\to J_i$ are quasi-isomorphisms. No filteredness, finite-cover hypothesis, or colimit site is required.

proof.text: Construct products of systems directly. At j take the product of the component sheaves. The a-transition has each projection equal to inverse image of the corresponding component projection followed by its transition. Projection tests, naturality of e.unit and e.comp and the component system laws prove identity and cocycle. The component projections are system maps; the componentwise product lift is compatible and is the unique such lift, again by projection tests. This constructs HasProducts for all index sets in universe u, including the empty set.

proof.text: Take the mono-preserving left adjoint from lem-per-varying-site-system-evaluation-adjoints. The right-adjoint injectivity lemma proves that evaluation carries injective systems to injective component sheaves.

source.place: Tags 09WG (5)-(7) and 09WH, free evaluation construction, generalized to arbitrary small categories and specified inverse-image coherence; cofree construction from sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0EXZ.

proof.text: For a system F choose injective embeddings u_i:F_i→A_i in the abelian sheaf categories. Choose the right evaluation adjoints R_i and their adjunctions from lem-per-varying-site-system-evaluation-adjoints. Exact evaluation preserves monomorphisms, so the right-adjoint injectivity lemma makes R_i A_i injective. The system G=∏_i R_i A_i is injective by product-injectives. Let f:F→G have i-projection the adjunct of u_i. If x≫f=y≫f, project to R_i A_i and transpose; naturality of the Hom bijection gives ev_i(x)≫u_i=ev_i(y)≫u_i. Cancel u_i. Equality at every i is equality of compatible families, so x=y and f is monic. This constructs an InjectivePresentation of every F, hence EnoughInjectives. The same argument works when I is empty by extensionality of empty families.

source.place: Tag 0EXZ, lemma-colim-sites-injective, category of systems; agent generalization to specified coherent inverse images over any small category.

proof.text: Apply the existing bounded-below monomorphic injective-resolution theorem with the given b and K. Its complex J and map s have the required lower bound, injective terms, component monomorphisms and system quasi-isomorphism. Evaluation preserves injectives by the preceding argument, giving the injective component terms. Additive evaluation preserves finite limits and colimits, hence homology, and therefore takes s to a quasi-isomorphism at every vertex. No hypothesis on filtering or a colimit site has been used.

lean.statement: theorem varyingSiteSystem_injective_resolutions {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] (D : VaryingSiteDiagram.{u} I) (e : VaryingSiteCoherence D) : ∃ (_ : Abelian (VaryingSiteSystem D e)), ∃ (_ : ∀ i : I, (VaryingSiteSystem.evaluation D e i).Additive), EnoughInjectives (VaryingSiteSystem D e) ∧ (∀ i : I, PreservesFiniteLimits (VaryingSiteSystem.evaluation D e i) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (VaryingSiteSystem.evaluation D e i) ∧ ∀ F : VaryingSiteSystem D e, Injective F → Injective (F.obj i)) ∧ (∀ (F G : VaryingSiteSystem D e) (h : F ⟶ G) (c : KernelFork h), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ↔ ∀ i : I, Nonempty (IsLimit ((VaryingSiteSystem.evaluation D e i).mapCone c))) ∧ (∀ (F G : VaryingSiteSystem D e) (h : F ⟶ G) (c : CokernelCofork h), Nonempty (IsColimit c) ↔ ∀ i : I, Nonempty (IsColimit ((VaryingSiteSystem.evaluation D e i).mapCocone c))) ∧ ∀ (b : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex (VaryingSiteSystem D e) ℤ), (∀ n : ℤ, n < b → IsZero (K.X n)) → ∃ (J : CochainComplex (VaryingSiteSystem D e) ℤ) (s : K ⟶ J), (∀ n : ℤ, n < b → IsZero (J.X n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Injective (J.X n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Mono (s.f n)) ∧ QuasiIso s ∧ (∀ (i : I) (n : ℤ), Injective ((J.X n).obj i)) ∧ ∀ i : I, QuasiIso (((VaryingSiteSystem.evaluation D e i).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map s)
